crossRefs.note: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came…
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has…
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…

translations.web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
translations.bsb: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
translations.kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
translations.asv: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
